scope.boundary: ITIS 2026-08-26 has no exact accepted Oomycota phylum root. Its broader ancestors for the two shared orders follow an historical Fungi/Myxomycota/Phycomycota path, so they are not treated as an Oomycota root. This sidecar therefore covers only strict COL26.8 accepted species below the two exact shared accepted order roots Peronosporales and Saprolegniales; every other COL Oomycota and every remaining Protists and Chromists species is explicitly out of scope.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: Do not infer an ITIS Oomycota root from a broader historical lineage. Use only the two exact shared accepted order names/ranks, and keep the remaining COL Oomycota species out of scope.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one accepted ITIS species within the selected shared-order union and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS non-current species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one accepted ITIS species within the selected shared-order union.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one accepted ITIS species TSN within the selected shared-order union.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact accepted-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to an accepted ITIS species within the selected shared-order union.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, taxon-substituted, or broader-lineage matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk only for the two shared order roots of the COL26.8 Oomycota partition. It does not assert that ITIS supplies an Oomycota root, or that its historical broader lineage is a usable Oomycota classification. It is not a global oomycete checklist, final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier or scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车仅是 COL26.8 Oomycota 分区中两个双方精确共有目根的冻结严格命名交叉映射。它不声称 ITIS 提供 Oomycota 根，也不把 ITIS 的历史性更宽谱系当作可用的 Oomycota 分类。它不是全球卵菌名录、最终分类权威、系统发育、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案或科学审查记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; one detail query loads exactly one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned. The complete selected-order ITIS-only current-species partition is in its own immutable JSONL gzip shard.

deliveryProfiles.web: web-light: descriptor, scope, counts, source and immutable file hashes only; no row-level shard is eligible for Pages.
deliveryProfiles.android: native-full: descriptor and every non-empty listed COL-ID and upstream-only row shard.
deliveryProfiles.ios: native-full: descriptor and every non-empty listed COL-ID and upstream-only row shard.
